apropos.title: Cultivating Excellence in the Heart of the Sahel.
apropos.description: OPE Agadez is a bold initiative designed to uncover and propel young Nigerian talents. We believe that innovation springs from the union of our rich cultural heritage and tomorrow's technologies.
apropos.pilier_1_desc: Access to intensive training programs designed to address both current and upcoming technological challenges.
apropos.pilier_2_desc: We transform raw ideas into tangible solutions. By providing the tools, mentorship, and ecosystem required, we catalyze the creation of startups with strong social and economic impact.
apropos.pilier_3_desc: Connecting young talents with experienced mentors and industry leaders to forge sustainable collaborations.
apropos.inspiration_quote: The desert is not a limitation, it is a springboard for the mind.
apropos.timeline_subtitle: Discover the milestones that shaped the history and impact of OPE Agadez since its inception.
apropos.editorial_title: At the heart of the Aïr mountains, Agadez reinvents Niger's hub of excellence.
apropos.editorial_quote: A historic center listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, Agadez has guarded the routes of knowledge for centuries. Here, OPE unites youth for the CNCEIZ camp.
apropos.editorial_p1: Carrying the torch from Niger's brilliant participation in the 2024 UNESCO Center for Peace World Camp at Hood College, the camp pursues a clear ambition: train skilled, committed, and proud youth.
apropos.editorial_p2: The journey begins in November 2026 with Pre-Camps across eight regions and Timia for 1,500 youth. In December, 1,000 delegates will gather in Agadez for seven days of creation.
apropos.hood_p1: Summer 2024. Eight young Nigerien ambassadors flew the nation's colors high at the UNESCO Center for Peace World Camp at Hood College.
apropos.hood_p2: Resounding victories at IMUN (African Union), 1st Prize in STEAM led by Sigma Team with Miss Mathematics Mariam Harouna Koché, and 2 prestigious awards honoring OPE's dedication.
apropos.pillars_subtitle: A framework designed to spark vocations and provide concrete solutions to the Sahel.
apropos.p_education_desc: Hands-on learning: technical, scientific, and civic training, conferences, and expert mentorship to tackle current and future challenges.
apropos.p_tech_sub: When youth invents the future of Niger.
apropos.p_tech_desc: AI, robotics, biotech, art, and math: STEAM workshops place youth at the center of creation. Pitches, expos, and local project exhibits make Agadez an open-air idea lab.
apropos.p_impact_desc: Tree planting, school repairs, community health clinics, Back to School drives, 7km Peace Run, and solar kits donations: moving from words to deeds.
apropos.p_tourism_sub: Agadez, living memory of the Sahel.
apropos.p_tourism_desc: A UNESCO World Heritage city providing a unique setting: guided heritage tours, craft valorization, girl child support, and sports empowerment.
apropos.p_network_desc: Connecting young talents with seasoned mentors to build sustainable collaborations across all eight regions.

acteurs.hero_subtitle: Institutional personalities and partners — discover the words of those who make CNCEIZ a reality.
acteurs.presi_subtitle: Organization for the Promotion of Excellence (OPE)
acteurs.presi_quote: Niger is the youngest country in the world. This demographic reality, often cited as a challenge, is in truth our most precious and underutilized resource.
acteurs.presi_p1: Some projects are born from observation, and others from deep conviction. The National Citizen Camp for Excellence and Innovation is one of them. It was born from the profound conviction that Niger's youth does not need someone to invent a future for them; they need a platform worthy of what they are already capable of achieving.
acteurs.presi_p2: Niger is the youngest country in the world. In workshops without electricity, in dusty schoolyards, in dimly lit rooms in Niamey, Zinder, Maradi, Tahoua, and Agadez, thousands of young people build prototypes and design creative solutions. What they need is a national stage where their country turns to them and says: we see you, we acknowledge you, you are our future.
acteurs.presi_p3: The National Citizen Camp for Excellence and Innovation is that stage. That moment. That declaration.
acteurs.presi_p4: By establishing its moral seat in Agadez, a millenary city and UNESCO World Heritage site, the Camp sends a strong message: Nigerien excellence is a historical reality that today's generation is called to rekindle with pride.
acteurs.presi_p5: We invite you to join this endeavor not as mere donors, but as builders. Founding partners of this edition will be etched into the first page of history of an annual national event.
acteurs.sg_subtitle: Organization for the Promotion of Excellence (OPE)
acteurs.sg_quote: They ask to be heard, guided, and given a chance to prove their worth. The National Citizen Camp for Excellence and Innovation is our answer.
acteurs.sg_p1: Some commitments are made in boardrooms. Others are made before a youth showing you their project with sparkling eyes. For me, everything started there.
acteurs.sg_p2: Since the creation of OPE, I have met young people who code, farm, invent, and organize with whatever they have at hand. They don't ask for miracles; they ask for an opportunity to show what they are worth.
acteurs.sg_p3: The National Citizen Camp for Excellence and Innovation is our answer. It brings together young people aged 12 to 35 in STEAM, Local Projects, and Citizen Community Model.
acteurs.sg_p4: Niger is engaged in its refoundation. If we want a solid country tomorrow, we must invest today in those who will carry it.
acteurs.sg_p5: My personal commitment is simple: stand beside these young people and ensure every serious idea finds an open door.
acteurs.sg_p6: To the youth: apply and bring your ideas. The camp is made to make them flourish.
acteurs.sg_p7: To partners and supporters: join us as builders of this first edition.
acteurs.sg_p8: Niger doesn't have to look far for its talents. We simply need to open the door for them.
